sources.title: L'essayiste Natacha Polony annonce sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle
Présidentielle 2027 : «Je suis candidate», annonce la journaliste Natacha Polony

summary: Essayist Natacha Polony, former director of Marianne and founder of the movement Nous sommes la France, announced her candidacy for the 2027 presidential election on France Inter on 14 October 2026. She is not in candidates.yaml.
